episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: With their lives upended by tragedy, Rose's place is uncertain as Lissa faces a new role in court.

episodes.title: Earth. Air. Water. Fire.
episodes.summary: Lissa fears the world will learn her secret; Rose must face the consequences of her actions.

episodes.title: Death Watch
episodes.summary: The Dominion suffers a great loss; Rose meets her match; Christian receives shocking news.

episodes.title: Benchmark
episodes.summary: Rose faces a defining test as a Guardian; Victor offers Lissa a chance to improve the Dominion.

episodes.title: Near Guard, Far Guard
episodes.summary: Rose proves she's a great leader, but at a terrible cost; Lissa takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Molinija
episodes.summary: On the royal tour, Rose tries to find peace; Lissa seeks answers about her magic.

episodes.title: Beyond the Wards
episodes.summary: Rose and Lissa's quest for answers leads them beyond the borders of the world they've always known.

episodes.title: The Trials
episodes.summary: The fight for the throne comes to a head; Victor hides his secret; Rose investigates the enemy.

episodes.title: Darkness
episodes.summary: The aftermath of the Trials throws the Dominion into chaos; Christian faces a horrific truth.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.summary: The citizens of the Dominion must come together to face their greatest threat yet.
